safety_lead_time.comparison_action: Increase safety lead time from 0.0 to 1.80 days

narrative: Material PL3__MF5A1654 exhibits intermittent high-volume demand averaging 1,559 units per working day with a CV of 0.62, driven primarily by zero-demand days on non-production days. Lead times are volatile (CV=0.81) with a bimodal distribution suggesting a mix of same-day and multi-day replenishment cycles. The current SAP safety stock of 183 units is critically under-dimensioned given the lead-time demand uncertainty (sigma_LTD=1,709), and the (r,Q) policy with safety stock of 2,812 and order quantity of 5,914 is recommended to achieve 95% service level while consolidating ordering frequency and reducing total annual cost by 94%.
warnings: Storage capacity fully utilised: safety_stock (2812) + order_quantity (5914) = 8726 = max_storage_units. No headroom for safety stock increases.
Volatile lead times (CV=0.81) significantly inflate buffer requirements. Monitor supplier performance closely.
Intermittent demand pattern: 26.9% zero-demand days detected; verify whether these reflect true zero consumption or data gaps.

research_insights.selected_model: (r, Q) — Fixed Reorder Point, Fixed Order Quantity (EOQ-based)
research_insights.selection_rationale: With continuous working-day demand observations, a single replenishment echelon, and no evidence of complex multi-echelon or batch constraints beyond MOQ, the classical (r,Q) policy is optimal. EOQ minimises total ordering plus holding cost; the reorder point r = mean demand over effective lead time + safety stock provides the 95% service level buffer against joint demand and lead-time variability.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage is at 100% utilisation under the recommended policy (8,726/8,726 units). Any upward revision to safety stock — triggered by lead-time spikes or demand surges — would require either a storage capacity expansion or an explicit service level trade-down. This constraint should be reviewed quarterly.
research_insights.escalation_flag: No MOQ-capacity infeasibility (MOQ 183 + SS 2812 = 2995 < 8726). Capacity binds only at the EOQ order quantity level. Recommend reviewing max_storage_units for potential expansion to allow full unconstrained EOQ of 9,227 units.
